Two PhD positions (1xAI/1xUX focused) at Eindhoven University of Technology.

Can agentic AI help us to characterize gameplay, linking gameplay pattern to player experience, benefitting policy-making, serious games, and game design?

Can agentic AI help us to characterize gameplay, linking gameplay pattern to player experience, benefitting policy-making, serious games, and game design?

If you are excited about using Agentic AI to play games, characterise gameplay pattern, and innovate how we are comprehending video games design—a medium exciting billions—you might be the right candidate for our GameAI PhD position:

If you are excited about developing, evaluating, and applying methodology to link gameplay pattern to player experience and build thus far largest library of play experience you might be right candidate for our Player Experience position:

The project is funded by the European Research Council (ERC) under the Starting Grants scheme and offers two four-year position including training and travel with the aim to build a robust AI-powered methodology to characterise gameplay.

You will work embedded in a passionate team at Eindhoven University of Technology, Netherlands, surrounded by leading experts in Human-Technology Interaction and Design.
